scope: Bounded JSON shape and input-size validation for POST /auth/login/mfa

criteria.description: The MFA login route casts arbitrary parsed JSON and accesses payload.userId before establishing an object boundary; userId, token and challengeId have no route-level maximum length contract.
criteria.limitations: Source-level selection evidence; dedicated RED remains required.

criteria.description: The smallest safe correction is a route-local MFA payload validator after the existing IP/identity rate-limit check and before AuthService.completeMfaLogin, with no MFA protocol or session redesign.
criteria.limitations: No change to challenge signing, lockout, TOTP, enrollment, refresh or session policy is authorized.

criteria.description: The existing route test seam can prove malformed and oversized payloads return sanitized 400 responses without invoking AuthService while retaining a successful MFA response and identity rate-limit behavior.
criteria.limitations: Fresh RED/GREEN and affected regression are pending.

gaps: The intentional route RED, implementation, regression, quality and review are not complete at gate creation.
conditions: Keep rate limiting before payload validation and never include token/challenge/body in rate-limit identity or logs.
Preserve the global ERP IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL and promotion BLOCKED state.

authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via fresh local residual scouting after the bounded auth login input closure
authority.decision: Authorize reversible route/helper/test changes for JSON object validation and maximum lengths only. Exclude challenge protocol, lockout/TOTP policy, enrollment, WebAuthn, refresh/session redesign, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment, release and global ERP promotion.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before changing MFA challenge semantics, lockout/TOTP policy, session behavior, rate-limit backend or any target/production surface.

revalidation_triggers: Changing the MFA challenge token or repository protocol
Changing lockout, TOTP, enrollment, WebAuthn or session semantics
Changing auth rate-limit ordering or distributed backend
Any provider, target, production, deployment or release operation
next_action: Write and run the intentional RED before changing auth-routes implementation.
